assumptions: Git command output, commit ancestry, and the declared uncertain paths describe the local syntactic observation domain accurately.
compatibility: AIM 0.2, confluence certificates, assurance classes, and the analysis-report 0.1.0-alpha schema remain unchanged.
domain: Local non-bare Git repositories with a common ancestor base, committed changes or same-repository worktrees, and tracked or non-ignored untracked paths.
execution_contract: Read-only Git subprocesses and an explicit output artifact outside repository semantics; no checkout, index update, merge, commit, agent, network, or external effect.
hypotheses: Exact Git path snapshots plus declared dependencies can provide useful syntactic candidates while unsupported or incomplete cases remain unknown.
observation_contract: Resolved commit hashes, two equal worktree snapshots, normalized paths, input digest, and the separately emitted provenance artifact.
